Trade shocks and trade policy don't hit "the economy" — they hit individual
firms, unevenly, depending on what they export, how they're organised, and
how productive they already were. This hub collects the firm- and
product-level microdata work that sits underneath the country-level
headlines in the other hubs.

**Compliance with non-tariff measures acts as a quality filter: firms that
clear stricter standards see productivity and price-premium gains, while
firms that can't absorb the compliance cost exit export markets
entirely** — a pattern that shows up across Ukrainian food-processing,
UK services exports, and Ukrainian manufacturing alike.
